name: 崩崩
prompt_en: A designer toy plush charm of a small chubby child, 1.5-head proportion. On top of its head sits a prominent tomato-red flame-shaped squishy blob, the main focal point, with slow-rebound silicone texture. Round face, angry slanted brows, small black bead eyes, puffed cheeks, fists clenched, one foot stamping. Cream-white short-pile plush body, no extra accessories. Vinyl face with plush body, keychain loop on top. Matte, slightly fuzzy texture, light grey background, soft studio lighting, full-body front view.
prompt_zh: 一只 1.5 头身的团子小孩潮玩，头顶长着一团番茄红色、火苗形状的软胶"火气团"，火气团是主角、体积明显、表面有慢回弹的硅胶质感。圆脸，倒竖的八字眉，黑色豆豆眼，两颊气鼓鼓地鼓起来，双手攥拳、一只脚在跺地。奶白色短绒身体，无多余装饰。搪胶毛绒挂件形态，顶部有挂扣。哑光、微绒质感，浅灰背景，柔和棚拍光，正面全身构图。

name: 挂挂
prompt_en: A designer toy of a small dusty-blue long-pile fluff ball, 1-head round body, with two extra-long droopy arms hooked over the top edge of a computer monitor so the body hangs in front of the screen. Very wide-set, half-closed eyes, blank zoned-out expression, a single-line mouth. A tiny neon-yellow ID badge on its chest. Long fluffy plush texture, bendable soft arms. Office desk setting, blurred background, natural side light, close-up shot.
prompt_zh: 一只雾灰蓝色长绒小毛团潮玩，身体是 1 头身的圆团子，最突出的是两条超长、下垂的手臂，正挂在一台显示器的上沿，身体垂在屏幕前面。两只眼睛间距很宽、半垂着、表情放空，一条线的嘴。胸前挂着一个荧光黄色小工牌。长绒质感，手臂柔软可弯。办公桌场景，背景虚化，自然侧光，近景构图。

name: 卷卷
prompt_en: A designer toy of a small standing lamb, 1.5-head proportion. The focal point is its two horns: each horn is a half-unwound coil of acacia-yellow yarn with a loose thread hanging down. Oatmeal-white curly fleece body, curly fringe, sleepy eyes squeezed into lines, faint blush, hugging one of its yarn horns with both arms. Knitted plush texture with visible yarn detail. Warm beige background, soft lighting, full-body front view.
prompt_zh: 一只 1.5 头身的小羊潮玩，直立，最突出的是头顶两只羊角：每只角都是一卷半松开的金合欢黄色毛线，线头垂下来一截。燕麦白色卷毛身体，卷毛刘海，困到眯成一条线的眼睛，淡淡腮红，双手抱着自己的一只毛线角。针织毛绒质感，能看到毛线纹理。暖米色背景，柔和光线，正面全身构图。

name: 晒晒
prompt_en: A designer toy of a small standing cat, 2-head proportion, with caramel tan short fur. The focal point is a crisp white sunglasses-shaped tan line across its face with strong contrast. Sunglasses with sea-teal lenses pushed up on top of its head, cat ears, small triangle cat mouth, relaxed confident expression, hands on hips. Short plush texture. Bright beach sunlight, pale sand background, full-body front view.
prompt_zh: 一只 2 头身、直立的小猫潮玩，小麦焦糖色短毛，脸上最突出的是一圈墨镜形状的白色晒痕，晒痕边缘清楚、对比强烈。墨镜推在头顶，镜片是海王绿色，猫耳，小三角猫嘴，表情松弛自信，双手叉腰。短绒质感。明亮海边阳光，浅沙色背景，正面全身构图。

name: 潮潮
prompt_en: A designer toy of a small water sprite, 2-head proportion, sea-teal skin. The focal point is its hair made of clear jelly-like water droplets, with drops dripping from the tips. Large solid black eyes without pupils, tiny dot nose, single-line mouth, a touch of coral blush. Holding a small clear puddle in both hands. Matte soft-vinyl body, glossy transparent hair. Rain-streaked window background, cool soft light, full-body front view.
prompt_zh: 一只 2 头身的小水妖潮玩，海王绿色皮肤，最突出的是头发：由透明果冻质感的水滴组成，水滴正从发梢往下滴。全黑、没有瞳孔的大眼睛，小圆点鼻子，一条线的嘴，脸颊一点珊瑚粉。双手捧着一个小小的透明水坑。身体哑光软胶质感，头发透明发亮。雨后玻璃窗背景，冷色柔光，正面全身构图。

name: 挂挂 v2
prompt_en: A designer toy of a small fluff ball in soft lilac ribbed-knit texture, 1-head round body. The focal point is two extra-long droopy arms ending in small round hands, hooked over the top edge of a computer monitor so the body hangs in front of the screen. Very wide-set half-closed eyes, blank zoned-out expression, a single-line mouth. A tiny neon-yellow ID badge on its chest. Visible knit texture, soft bendable arms. Plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, full-body front view.
prompt_zh: 一只平和淡紫色罗纹针织质感的小毛团潮玩，1 头身圆团子，最突出的是两条超长、下垂的手臂，手臂末端是圆圆的小手，正挂在一台显示器的上沿，身体垂在屏幕前面。两只眼睛间距很宽、半垂着、表情放空，一条线的嘴。胸前挂着一个荧光黄色小工牌。可见针织纹理，柔软可弯。纯浅灰背景，柔和棚拍光，正面全身构图。

name: 嗯嗯
prompt_en: A designer toy of a small puppy, 1.5-head proportion, cream-white short plush. The focal point is its left ear: a glossy luminous cobalt-blue vintage telephone receiver, while the right ear is a normal soft floppy ear, asymmetric. The puppy tilts its head, pointing the receiver ear forward, small black bead eyes, tiny dot nose, mouth slightly open as if saying 'mm-hm'. Minimal, no extra clothing. Vinyl-face plush charm format. Plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, three-quarter full-body view.
prompt_zh: 一只 1.5 头身的小狗潮玩，奶油白短绒，最突出的是左边的耳朵：它是一只亮面的明亮钴蓝色复古电话听筒，右边是普通的软软垂耳，不对称。小狗歪着头，把听筒耳朵对着前方，黑色豆豆眼，小圆点鼻子，小嘴微微张开像在说"嗯"。极简，无多余服装。搪胶毛绒挂件形态。纯浅灰背景，柔和棚拍光，四分之三侧全身构图。

name: 落落
prompt_en: A designer toy of a small cream-white dough-like creature, 1.5-head round body. The focal point is a bright red map location pin growing from the top of its head, shaped like an upside-down teardrop, clearly prominent. Small black bead eyes, faint blush, single-line smile. Holding a tiny blank city card in both hands. Short plush texture, clean plain body. Plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, full-body front view.
prompt_zh: 一只 1.5 头身的米白色小面团潮玩，最突出的是头顶长着一枚鲜红色的地图定位针，形状像倒过来的水滴，体积明显。黑色豆豆眼，淡淡腮红，一条线的微笑。双手捧着一张小小的空白城市卡片。短绒质感，素体干净。纯浅灰背景，柔和棚拍光，正面全身构图。

name: 方方
prompt_en: A designer toy shaped like a round ancient coin with a square hole, maize-yellow. The focal point is the square hole in the center: a tiny face peeks out of it, small black bead eyes, small cat-like mouth, faint blush. Two tiny stubby hands stick out from the sides, cupped together in a respectful greeting. A small vermilion cord knot tied on top. Glossy soft vinyl texture with slightly worn edges. Plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, front view.
prompt_zh: 一枚圆形铜钱造型的拟物潮玩，玉米黄色，最突出的是中间的方孔：一张小脸正从方孔里探出来，黑色豆豆眼、小猫嘴、淡淡腮红。铜钱两侧伸出两只小短手，正抱拳作揖。顶部系着一个朱红色小绳结。亮面软胶质感，边缘有轻微磨旧的纹理。纯浅灰背景，柔和棚拍光，正面构图。

name: 搭搭
prompt_en: A designer toy pair of two small children standing side by side, 2-head proportion, one in soft lilac and one in maize yellow. The focal point is a jigsaw-puzzle shape on top of each head, one with a tab and one with a slot, so they fit together. Both have small black bead eyes, single-line mouths, short hair, each reaching one hand toward the other. Short plush texture, minimal. Plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, full-body front view.
prompt_zh: 两个 2 头身的小孩潮玩并排站着，一个平和淡紫色、一个玉米黄色，最突出的是两人头顶各有一块拼图结构，一个是凸起、一个是凹口，正好能扣在一起。两人都是黑色豆豆眼、一条线的嘴、短发，各伸出一只手指向对方。短绒质感，极简。纯浅灰背景，柔和棚拍光，正面全身构图。

name: 格格
prompt_en: A designer toy of a small girl, 2-head proportion. The focal point is that her whole silhouette has pixel-stepped edges and her surface shows individual cylindrical fuse beads, with one bead deliberately the wrong color and slightly crooked. Two square beads as eyes, a single horizontal-line mouth, two pink beads as blush, holding one bead in her hand. Low-saturation multicolor palette, matte bead-textured surface. Plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, full-body front view.
prompt_zh: 一个 2 头身的小女孩潮玩，最突出的是整个身体和头部的轮廓都是像素阶梯状的边缘，表面能看到一颗颗圆柱形的拼豆颗粒，其中一颗颜色故意不对、微微歪着。两颗方形豆子做眼睛，一条横线的嘴，两颗粉色豆子做腮红，手里捏着一颗豆子。低饱和的多彩配色，颗粒感哑光表面。纯浅灰背景，柔和棚拍光，正面全身构图。
